SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM order_item GROUP BY product_id) oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 1
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (p.category_id = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_category WHERE parent_id = #{categoryId}))
AND p.price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.price <= #{maxPrice}
AND p.original_price IS NOT NULL AND p.original_price > p.price
AND p.is_international = 1
ORDER BY IFNULL(oi.sold, 0) DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.price ASC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.price DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.stock DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.original_price IS NOT NULL AND p.original_price > p.price ORDER BY (p.original_price - p.price) / p.original_price DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.*, c.category_name as categoryName, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS soldCount FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, c.category_name ORDER BY soldCount DESC, p.stock DESC LIMIT #{limit}
